name: Slamming Gate
disable: DC 15 Thievery check (trained) to loosen the gate's springs before it slams closed
reset: The trap can be reactivated (or deactivated, if it's active) by flipping a lever hidden in the nearby wall. A character Searching the area finds it with a successful DC 18 Perception check check.

items.name: Slam Shut
items.text:
Trigger The door is opened more than halfway

---

Effect The door slams shut and deals 3d8 bludgeoning damage to any creature in the way (DC 17 basic Reflex save). On a critical failure, the creature is also Restrained by the closed door until it Escapes

text: The heavy gate slams shut when opened more than halfway
